papers.title_en: Robust Multi-Agent Pursuit with Preemptive Communication via Reachability-Based Control Barrier Functions
papers.evidence: 基于可达集与控制屏障函数的机器人安全多智能体协调
papers.tldr: 真实多机器人系统通信资源受限，持续完美状态共享难以保证，间歇通信下安全协同成为难题。本文提出控制/通信统一策略，各智能体基于上次接收状态计算邻居可达集，并用控制屏障函数求安全控制，同时以不确定性风险与运动学风险度量触发抢占式通信。仿真多类追逃场景表明，该方法较周期与事件触发基线减少77.5%消息量且零碰撞，并证明通信陈旧度有界即可保证智能体间避碰。
papers.abstract_en: Safe multi-agent coordination typically assumes what real-world, deployed, resource-constrained robots cannot provide: continuous, perfect state sharing. Robust control strategies must be complemented with robust communication strategies to deliver resilient deployments. In this work, we propose a unified control/communication strategy that provides safe control to guarantee inter-agent safety under intermittent communication and demonstrate its effectiveness in a pursuit-evasion scenario. Each agent computes the reachable set of neighboring agents based on the last state information received, then solves for a safe control input based on control barrier functions to ensure agents avoid collision. We prove that inter-agent collision avoidance is guaranteed provided communication staleness remains bounded. As the reachable set inflates between state transmissions, each agent reasons about when to preemptively transmit its state information to neighboring agents based on novel metrics characterizing uncertainty risk and kinematic risk. We implement and simulate a variety of pursuit-evasion scenarios and show that preemptive communication reduces messages by 77.5% compared to periodic and event-triggered baselines with zero collisions.

papers.title_en: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
papers.authors: Guowei Xu, Zhenting Qi, Amani Kiruga, Himabindu Lakkaraju, Yilun Du
papers.evidence: 在去中心化智能体集群中联合学习动作策略与自组织协调
papers.tldr: 现有群体智能系统多在固定编排结构下训练个体，割裂了能力学习与协作组织。本文提出基于市场的后训练（MPT），让去中心化智能体群体通过竞价决定参与，并联合学习动作策略与自编排。在具身合成、机器人导航和深度研究中，MPT 优于单体后训练，学习到的自编排也胜过其他协调策略。该方法支持复用、扩展与鲁棒性，为群体智能训练提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT.

papers.title_en: From Solo to Ensemble: A Hierarchical Framework for Composable Multi-Agent Human-Object Interaction
papers.authors: Zekai Deng, Kangyi Chen, Ye Shi, Jingya Wang
papers.evidence: 多智能体协作操作与协调
papers.tldr: 物理仿真的人-物交互已具备稳健单智能体操作能力，但扩展到多智能体协作仍困难。现有方法依赖任务特定微调，将低层接触执行与高层协调耦合，难以跨物体几何、交互类型和团队规模复用。本文提出分层框架，把单智能体HOI策略转化为可复用的面向物体运动技能：从教师轨迹提取物体代理运动监督，蒸馏低层技能，再用高层策略生成区域级物体导向动作协调多智能体。实验表明该技能支持稳健执行，并可组合学习跨不同交互、物体和团队规模。
papers.abstract_en: Physics-based human-object interaction has achieved robust single-agent manipulation skills, yet extending them to multi-agent cooperative tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches typically adapt interaction policies through task-specific fine-tuning, which entangles low-level contact-rich execution with high-level coordination and limits reuse across object geometries, interaction types, and team sizes. We propose a hierarchical framework that converts a single-agent HOI policy into a reusable Object-oriented Motion Skill. Specifically, we reinterpret teacher rollouts as object-oriented action supervision by extracting short-horizon object-proxy motions from executed trajectories, and distill task-specific teachers into a low-level skill operating in an Object-oriented Action Space. For downstream tasks, the distilled skill is frozen as a reusable executor, while a high-level policy coordinates multiple agents by generating region-wise object-oriented actions conditioned on the shared object, task goal, agent states, and local manipulation regions. This formulation shifts multi-agent HOI learning from direct contact-rich full-body control to compact object-level proxy-motion coordination. Experiments on diverse HOI tasks show that the distilled Object-oriented Motion Skill supports robust proxy-motion execution and enables composable policy learning across different interaction types, object geometries, and team sizes.

papers.title_en: Non-Prehensile Multi-Object Placement with Mobile Robots via Diffusion-Based Trajectory Planning
papers.authors: Lance Pharand, Megnath Ramesh, Mark Chiu, Yash Vardhan Pant, Stephen L. Smith
papers.evidence: 面向多移动机器人的扩散轨迹规划与多目标任务分配
papers.tldr: 移动机器人非抓取操作多面向粗放区域放置，精密多物体放置因纠错需大幅绕行而困难。本文将多目标推动建模为紧公差多目标分配问题，提出因果分解扩散规划器：机器人去噪后以当前干净估计条件生成物体步骤，使单次机器人规划可采样多种物体结果，并设计推动专用代价用于引导与best-of-N采样。在Push-T取得最高成功率；三个仓库式多箱场景放置率提升21.5个百分点，重规划快1.8倍；TurtleBot 3 Burger上容差放置率85.0%，远超Diffusion Policy的37.5%。
papers.abstract_en: Non-prehensile manipulation with mobile robots has primarily targeted placement in coarse goal regions. Precision placement has been studied with manipulators on benchmarks such as Push-T, where an omnidirectional end effector can readily re-approach an object from any side. For a mobile robot, correcting the same placement errors may require wide repositioning maneuvers around the object. We formalize multi-object pushing with a mobile robot as a multi-target assignment problem at tight tolerances. We propose a diffusion planner with a causal factorization: each robot denoising step is followed by an object step conditioned on the current clean robot estimate. This factorization allows us to sample multiple object outcomes for a single robot plan, capturing the multi-modality of pushing. We also design a set of pushing-specific costs for mobile robots, used for both guidance and best-of-$N$ sampling at inference. On Push-T, our planner attains the highest success rate of the methods we compare, while having the lowest rate of implausible object motion. Across three multi-box pushing environments resembling warehouse scenarios, it raises the fraction of boxes placed by $21.5$ percentage points over an unguided baseline, and replans $1.8\times$ faster than a planner that denoises the two trajectories together. Lastly, we deploy the guided planner on a TurtleBot 3 Burger with object shapes absent from the training data, where it places $85.0\%$ of objects within tolerance against Diffusion Policy's $37.5\%$.

papers.title_en: Scalable Multi-Human Cooperative Manipulation via Commander-Executor Coordination
papers.authors: Buzhen Huang, Xingchen Wu, Yuanwang Yang, Chenyi Xie, Kun Li
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体协作操作的分层指挥官-执行者协调
papers.tldr: 多人类协同物体操作是人形控制中的难题，现有方法难以处理角色依赖、长时程与序列协作任务。为此，论文提出分层“指挥官-执行者”框架：指挥官融合指令与场景信息，进行语义与几何联合规划，将任务分解为角色特定子任务并生成以物体为中心的共享协调计划；执行者基于该高层策略与局部观测，通过单人到协作的课程学习低层物理策略。在多种物体操作任务中，方法能完成长时程、多类型协作组合任务，并可从双智能体扩展到多智能体，成功率优于现有最优方法。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-human cooperative object manipulation is a highly challenging topic in humanoid control. While existing methods can handle simple collaborative carrying tasks, they struggle with role-dependent, long-horizon, and sequential cooperative manipulation. To address this issue, we propose a hierarchical commander-executor framework that enables multiple agents to accomplish complex collaborative tasks in distinct ways. Specifically, a commander combines instructions and scene information for joint semantic and geometric planning. It then decomposes the task into role-specific subtasks and generates shared object-centric coordination plans, specifying execution timing, target positions, and manipulation actions for each agent. Conditioned on the commander's high-level strategy and each agent's local observations, the executor learns a low-level physics-based policy through a solo-to-cooperative curriculum to realize coordinated human-object interactions. The planned object trajectory provides a shared coordination target, while root positions and grasping instructions specify role-dependent execution cues. We evaluate our method on a variety of object manipulation tasks, demonstrating its ability to execute long-horizon tasks that combine different types of collaboration and to scale from two-agent to multi-agent cooperation. Extensive experiments further show that our approach achieves higher success rates compared to state-of-the-art methods. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/TJU-3DV/Co-Manipulation.

papers.title_en: A Responsibility-Centered Coordination Mechanism for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Thi-Nhung Nguyen, Viet-Thanh Pham, Linhao Luo, Thuy-Trang Vu, Dinh Phung
papers.evidence: 面向去中心化多智能体系统的以责任为中心的协调机制
papers.tldr: 集中式多智能体协调易遇扩展性与适应性瓶颈，去中心化虽缓解却使委托依赖与故障恢复的责任归属模糊。RCM 以承诺为核心，将任务委托与显式责任绑定，并通过递归委托让智能体保留上游责任、在本地编排下游承诺，形成责任可追溯的局部编排网络。它用责任约束决策与 RCP 通信协议支持承诺的建立、管理与终止，使全局协调从并行局部行动中涌现。在推理、编码与可执行智能体环境中，RCM 比强基线任务表现最高提升18.7分，责任指标提升10.2分，并增强故障与危害检测。
papers.abstract_en: Centralized orchestration provides comprehensive multi-agent coordination but creates bottlenecks in scalability, adaptability, and collective performance. Decentralized approaches alleviate these bottlenecks by distributing coordination across agents, yet often leave responsibility for delegated dependencies and failure recovery unclear. To address this gap, we propose RCM, a responsibility-centered coordination mechanism that leverages commitments to couple task delegation with explicit responsibilities of the involved parties. Through recursive delegation, agents retain their upstream responsibilities while locally orchestrating downstream commitments, thereby preserving accountability across delegation chains, creating a network of local orchestration. We operationalize this mechanism locally through responsibility-constrained decision-making and a responsibility-oriented communication protocol (RCP), enabling agents to autonomously establish, manage, and terminate commitments. As agents act in parallel, their local actions continuously evolve the commitment graph, allowing global coordination to emerge and adapt toward a shared mission without centralized control. Experiments across reasoning, coding, and executable agent environments demonstrate that RCM outperforms strong centralized and decentralized coordination baselines by up to 18.7 points in task performance and 10.2 points in Responsibility, while improving failure and harm detection without task-specific training.

papers.title_en: Auditable and Deployable Multi-Agent Motion Planning via Posetal Games from Legal Guidelines
papers.authors: Florian Lercher, Karan Mahesh, Yujun Huang, Meshal Alharbi, Runyu Zhang, Hanna Krasowski, Michael R. Benjamin, Matthias Althoff, Gioele Zardini
papers.evidence: 基于偏序博弈与法律约束的多智能体运动规划框架
papers.tldr: 机器人需在遵守法律约束下与其他智能体交互并完成目标，但目标常仅部分优先，标量化或全序层级不适用。该工作提出基于偏序博弈（posetal games）的多智能体运动规划框架：从场景无关法律指南自动生成智能体偏好与法律博弈，并允许私人目标细化。证明细化只会删除均衡从而保持合法性，并引入信念博弈与分布式迭代最佳响应协调。海上航行实验中，四船以内七个遭遇的违规均衡均被认证为法律层级强制或不可满足，且能由公开信息识别违规者，为部分指定法律到可审计运动规划提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: When robots are deployed in the real-world, they must interact with other agents and accomplish their own goals while adhering to legal constraints. These potentially conflicting objectives are often only partially prioritized, making scalarized objectives or fully specified hierarchies unsuitable. We present a framework for multi-agent motion planning under legal requirements based on games with partially ordered preferences (posetal games). Scenario-independent legal guidelines order abstract legal concerns, from which we automatically derive agent preferences and a legal game for any concrete scenario. Agents may refine their legal preferences with private objectives, and regulators may refine the guideline as laws evolve. We prove that such customizations can only remove equilibria and thus preserve legality. To coordinate agents without explicitly communicating private preferences, we introduce belief play, which provably recovers the true equilibria from conservative local games, and a distributed iterative best-response protocol requiring less information. We apply the framework to maritime navigation, systematically lifting pairwise traffic rules to multi-vessel encounters. On seven encounters with up to four vessels, every rule violation of the committed equilibria is certified as forced by the legal hierarchy or unsatisfiable, and defectors are identified from public information in all tested cases. These results indicate that guideline-based posetal games offer an auditable route from partially specified laws to multi-agent motion planning.

papers.title_en: UniW(A)M: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for World and World-Action Models
papers.authors: Jingbo Xu, Jianjie Fang, Zhuohang Li, Zihao Song, Zhaolu Wang, Xvyuan Liu, Xin Zhang, Haisheng Su, Yinzhou Tang, Chen Gao, Wei Wu, Yong Li
papers.evidence: 统一世界模型与世界动作模型表征环境动态
papers.tldr: 世界模型（WM）与世界-动作模型（WAM）虽共享具身轨迹中的物理动力学与交互语义，却通常被孤立训练，导致预测与控制之间难以复用知识。UniW(A)M 基于扩散 Transformer 构建混合专家框架，用共享专家捕捉通用动力学，用原子能力专家跨接口复用，并保持各接口独立条件通路。部署时由插件式自适应接口路由器 PAIR 依据少量目标任务片段选择合适 WAM 接口。在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 与三个真实操作任务上，真实世界平均成功率 88.3%，显著优于最强基线 76.7%，并在 WorldArena 三项任务上领先动作条件世界建模。
papers.abstract_en: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm.   We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen.   We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.

papers.authors: Edwin Mériaux, Antonio Loría, Gregory Dudek
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体部署与可视性的可复现环境生成器
papers.tldr: 机器人探索、覆盖与多智能体部署需要几何与可见性可控的可复现环境。本文提出开源 Dungeon and Visibility World Generator，支持二维/三维正交、多边形/多面体及曲线几何，覆盖散落房间、簇、蜿蜒通道、洞穴、分支和环路六类结构，参数可调。环境同时提供连续自由空间与离散占据表示，基于 Rust 引擎可查询任意位置视线。实验覆盖六类几何，分析几何与分辨率对可见性的影响，并评估生成时间与可复现性，为算法评测提供可配置基础。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms require reproducible environments with controllable geometry and visibility. This paper presents the Dungeon and Visibility World Generator, an open-source framework for constructing two- and three-dimensional environments and evaluating geometric line-of-sight. The framework supports orthogonal, polygonal or polyhedral, and curvilinear geometries, with six construction families covering scattered rooms, clusters, winding passages, caverns, branches, and loops. Room dimensions, passage structures, obstacles, and spatial placement can be controlled through configurable parameters and probability distributions. Each generated environment provides continuous free-space geometry and a corresponding discrete occupancy representation. A Rust-based visibility engine supports line-of-sight queries in both representations, enabling the evaluation of observable regions from arbitrary agent positions. The framework records configurations, generated geometries, occupancy grids, and visibility results to support reproducible experiments. We demonstrate the generator across all six geometry classes, examine how geometry and spatial resolution affect visibility, and evaluate generation time and reproducibility. The resulting framework provides a configurable foundation for evaluating robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms in diverse environments.
